node.title: Re: Cannot find my own modules
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Try:

use FindBin; use lib $FindBin::Bin; use basedat;

Update - Explanation: use basedat "$Bin/basedat"; is probably not doing what you want because it's just trying to pass the string "$Bin/basedat" to basedat->import() (see [doc://use]), it's not telling Perl where to actually find the module. To do that, you need to modify [doc://@INC], which I'm doing above with [doc://FindBin] and [doc://lib].
